title: Transaction Information
description: Response containing transaction data returned to the TPP based on the requested filters.

Account-Ref.description: **This parameter is required for GET Transactions and optional for GET Accounts and GET Balances.** Unique reference assigned to an account; when omitted (where optional), data is returned for all accounts linked to the client_id.
Account-Ref.title: Account Identifier

Accounts-Info.title: Accounts Information
Accounts-Info.description: Account identification and context details associated with the returned transactions.

account_name.description: Title given to the specific account.
account_name.title: Account Name

branch_name.description: Name of the local bank location offering financial services.
branch_name.title: Branch Name

branch_number.description: Number of the local bank located where the branch offers financial services.
branch_number.title: Branch Number

Consent-Id.description: Unique identifier of the account information consent used to authorize TPP data access.
Consent-Id.title: Consent Identifier

Transaction-Details.title: TransactionDetails
Transaction-Details.description: Detailed transaction record for an account entry returned by the transactions endpoint.

statement_date.description: Date on which the posting took place to the account.
statement_date.title: Statement Date

beneficiary.description: Party whose account is being credited.
beneficiary.title: Beneficiary

transaction_currency.description: Currency of the transaction instructed to be debited.
transaction_currency.title: Transaction Currency

amount.description: Transaction amount instructed to debit from debtor's account.
amount.title: Amount

bank_reference.description: Unique transaction reference generated by the bank.
bank_reference.title: Bank Reference

customer_reference.description: Unique transaction reference inputted by the customer.
customer_reference.title: Customer Reference

end_to_end_id.description: Unique transaction reference inputted by the customer.
end_to_end_id.title: end_to_end_id

entry_date.description: Date when the transaction was initiated.
entry_date.title: Entry Date

uetr.description: Unique end-to-end transaction reference, which should adhere to the pattern: ^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-4[a-f0-9]{3}-[89ab][a-f0-9]{3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$.
uetr.title: Uetr

bene_acct_no.description: Beneficiary account number. Party's account number to whose account is credited.
bene_acct_no.title: Beneficiary account number

org_acct_name.description: Original account name. The account name of the party that initiated the request.
org_acct_name.title: Originating account name

org_acct_no.description: Originating account number. The account number of the party that initiated the request.
org_acct_no.title: Originating account number

bene_name.description: Beneficiary Name. The name of the party whose account is being credited.
bene_name.title: Beneficiary Name

payment_details.description: A freeform text parameter where the ordering party bank user can enter some information about the transaction.
payment_details.title: Payment Details

iban_account_number.description: International Bank Account Number (IBAN). This is a standard international numbering system developed to identify an overseas bank account.
iban_account_number.title: Iban Account Number

bank_name.description: Name of the bank where the account is held.
bank_name.title: Bank Name

tran_detl.description: A freeform text parameter where the ordering party/bank user can enter some information about the transaction.
tran_detl.title: Transaction detail

bank_rte_id.description: Bank routing ID. The unique routing ID of each bank/branch.
bank_rte_id.title: Bank routing identifier

prod_typ.description: This parameter holds the payment type which was considered by the clearing system at the time of settlement.
prod_typ.title: Product type

credit_debit_mark.description:
Indicator of the transaction. Allowed values are
* D - Debit
* C - Credit
credit_debit_mark.title: Credit debit indicator

transaction_actual_time.description: Date when the transaction was initiated.
transaction_actual_time.title: transaction actual time
